verdict.rationale: Docs show concrete first-party SDK usage (composio.sessions.create, composio.mcp.create) plus a 'providers' adapter layer that maps Composio tools into native SDK/framework formats, and an OpenAPI spec is live, indicating a real programmable SDK surface for AI-native builders. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK listing (e.g., JS/TS vs Python parity), independent developer corroboration of SDK quality/reliability beyond docs.
